f3_program: offset(at("james.oreos.count", "current"), scale(at("jordan.oreos.count", "current"), 4), 7, "count", source("James has 7 more than 4 times the number of Oreos Jordan has"))
observe(at("james_and_jordan.oreos.count", "current"), 52, "count", source("there are 52 Oreos total"))
sum_relation(at("james_and_jordan.oreos.count", "current"), at("james.oreos.count", "current"), at("jordan.oreos.count", "current"), source("there are 52 Oreos total"))
query("value", at("james.oreos.count", "current"))
assumptions: The total of 52 refers to James's and Jordan's Oreos together.

f3_program: observe(at("company.uk_and_ireland.scope_2.purchased_energy_emissions", "FY18"), 32389, "tonnes_co2e", cell("Electricity, heat, steam and cooling purchased for own use (Scope 2)", "FY18**"))
observe(at("company.uk_and_ireland.scope_2.purchased_energy_emissions", "FY19"), 27633, "tonnes_co2e", cell("Electricity, heat, steam and cooling purchased for own use (Scope 2)", "FY19**"))
query("mean", at("company.uk_and_ireland.scope_2.purchased_energy_emissions", "FY18"), at("company.uk_and_ireland.scope_2.purchased_energy_emissions", "FY19"))
assumptions: The ** marker identifies the FY18 and FY19 columns as UK & Ireland only, as stated in the table footnote.

f3_program: observe(at("company.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2019"), 9.0, "usd_billion", cell("Cash, restricted cash and short-term marketable securities", "2019"))
observe(at("company.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2018"), 12.2, "usd_billion", cell("Cash, restricted cash and short-term marketable securities", "2018"))
observe(at("company.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2017"), 12.8, "usd_billion", cell("Cash, restricted cash and short-term marketable securities", "2017"))

query("mean", at("company.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2019"), at("company.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2018"), at("company.cash_restricted_cash_and_short_term_marketable_securities", "2017"))
assumptions: The table heading "($ in billions)" applies to all three values.

f3_program: collection("mara_and_luna.pink_crayons", "pink_crayon", "mara_and_luna", source("Mara has 40 crayons and 10 percent of her crayons are pink. Luna has 50 crayons and 20 percent of them are pink"))
observe(at("mara.crayons.count", "current"), 40, "count", source("Mara has 40 crayons"))
percent_of(at("mara_and_luna.pink_crayons.mara.count", "current"), at("mara.crayons.count", "current"), 10, source("10 percent of her crayons are pink"))
observe(at("luna.crayons.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("Luna has 50 crayons"))
percent_of(at("mara_and_luna.pink_crayons.luna.count", "current"), at("luna.crayons.count", "current"), 20, source("20 percent of them are pink"))
query("sum", "mara_and_luna.pink_crayons", "current")
collection("jeffrey.poultry_farm.chickens", "chicken", "jeffrey.poultry_farm", source("Jeffrey owns a poultry farm with 12 hens. For every 3 hens, there is 1 rooster. Each hen has 5 chicks"))
observe(at("jeffrey.poultry_farm.chickens.hens.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("12 hens"))
fraction_of(at("jeffrey.poultry_farm.chickens.roosters.count", "current"), at("jeffrey.poultry_farm.chickens.hens.count", "current"), 1, 3, source("For every 3 hens, there is 1 rooster"))
multiple(at("jeffrey.poultry_farm.chickens.chicks.count", "current"), at("jeffrey.poultry_farm.chickens.hens.count", "current"), 5, source("Each hen has 5 chicks"))
query("sum", "jeffrey.poultry_farm.chickens", "current")
assumptions: The requested chicken total comprises the hens, roosters, and chicks described in the source.
